notes.title: DLC "Desires Flowing" Available Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Mekaa Adventurers,[/h3]

After brainstorming and exploring for some time, we are presenting Desires Flowing DLC to you! We are creating this DLC not just to provide a new class option, but a new Follower mechanics, to explore more possibilities of deckbuilding gameplay.

Desires Flowing includes 3 Puppeteer characters, 100+ new class, a new Follower mechanics with over 30 Follower options, as well as new events, monsters and adventure stories. This stand-alone gameplay DLC is a bolder attempt from us to create a new class experience.

[h3]Today, we're thrilled to announce that Desires Flowing DLC is LIVE with a 20% launch discount![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2104380/Indiess_Lies__Alrayan_Undertow/

[h3]Greetings from Puppeteers[/h3]
Featuring gothic dark-themed art and unique mechanics, you'll play as the devout believer 'The Nun,' the precision killer 'Dark Doctor', and the gorgeous yet dangerous 'Blood Rose.' Why fight on the frontlines when you can be the mastermind behind the scenes?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/4520fda9e4c207e011d374dc5dc554de6291d217.jpg[/img]

[h3]Over 100 New Cards & New Follower Gameplay[/h3]
Build your deck from over 100 new cards made especially for the Puppeteers. Recruit Followers to join your team, and command them with key stats like Corruption, Brand, and Magic Copper Power. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/02bf430b36e74fa10570729035b42e3364da642c.png[/img]

[h3]Over 30 New Enemies with New Events[/h3]
Hunt beasts, dispel spirits, and navigate choices—from helping villagers to robbery in dark alleys. The DLC adds over 30 new enemies and random events, offering both challenges and opportunities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/6ca8894bb09ae2ba0895bc4505619e5756449af9.png[/img]

[h3]A New Chapter of the Mekaa Adventurer[/h3]
This DLC is rooted deep in the original lore, and you can piece together the story through the adventure mode gameplay.
After the leader of Puppeteer Naga’s mysterious disappearance, you embark on a journey to find her, only to realize she might be guiding you toward the dark mist’s end...

[h3]Base Game V2.0 Changes[/h3]

We have also made changes and fixes to the base game to ensure a smoother experience!

[list]
[*] Fixed the achievement "By All Odds". Players who meet the requirement will automatically gain the achievement
[*] Fixed the issue where reward coins can't transfer to the shop in Dragon Abyss mode
[*] Fixed the issue where the game gets stuck at Defeat screen in Dragon Abyss mode
[*] Fixed the card count issue of talent "Full Charge"
[*] Fixed the "Aura of Strenghth" duration issue within the Kemp enemy group
[*] Fixed the enemy intent delayed display bug (some enemy intents were displaying wrong number)
[*] Fixed the healing bug of card "Dust Regeneration"
[*] Fixed potential bugs related to "remove X cards of Y" in event options
[*] Fixed bugs that blocked Double Strike
[*] Fixed the target bug of card "Painkiller" and now it will target all enemies
[*] Fixed the bug where talent "Phantom" can't unlock library
[*] Fixed the healing hp of talent "Will to Survive" which were wrong under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed the rarity of the talent "Soar"
[/list]

[h3]Last but Not Least[/h3]
Indies' Lies is bundling with Union of Gnomes. Let's hooray for cards and enjoy an extra 10% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44438/

Fun Square Games

notes.title: DLC Testing LIVE Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Mekaa adventurers,[/h3]

Testing of the new DLC is officially LIVE! We would love to give the Indies' Lies community a taste of the new [Puppeteer] class where you recruit [Followers] to fight for you. We are eager for your feedback and we hope you enjoy the new mechanics!
[b]This test will last 72 hours and will conclude at 7PM Pacific time August 18.
[/b]

[h3]How to Join[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Make sure Indies' Lies is not running
[*] Right click on the game in your Steam Library
[*] Click "properties"
[*] Click the "BETAS" tab
[*] In the dropdown menu, choose "Puppeteer-test"
[*] Press close and wait for the game to update
[/olist]

[h3]Content[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Play as [b] [The Nun] [/b]under 20 Taint, access to all of her cards
[*] 10+ new enemies
[*] Access to all features of the new Follower mechanics where you recruit your Followers & groom your team - Select your followers from 30+ options, upgrade them and have them fight by your side. Every puppet has it specific intention in each turn. Here are a few new mechanics in the Follower gameplay[/olist]
[list][*] Trigger: Cards with the keyword Trigger can make your puppets execute their intentions additionally within a turn.
[*] Brand: Your followers will prioritize attacking the enemies with the most brands.
[*] Corrosion: Corrosion will cause damage to the target ignoring it’s armor. There's also "Worship" to offset Corrosion damage.
[*] Magic Copper Power: Cards with the keyword Magic Copper Power can endow your followers a powerful and dangerous only-one-turn effect.[/list]

[h3]Your Feedback Matters[/h3]
Submit bugs or suggestions via [url=https://forms.gle/YEZt9AYbgooihyV4A]this form[/url],
Or join us for feedback and discussion on the Steam community hub or [url=https://discord.gg/fPcPvfKbCk]official Indies' Lies Discord server[/url] in the #dlc-test channel!
[b]1 player with the most valuable feedback (decided by the dev team) & 1 random player will each get a DLC key upon release![/b]

[h3]If you like what you see, wishlist the DLC!
[/h3]
Releasing on August 29 with a 20% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3097790/Indies_Lies__Desires_Flowing/

Enjoy!
Fun Square

notes.title: DLC Art & Design Reveal | Letter from Lady Mystery
notes.content:
[h3]✉️Pleased to meet you, adventurers.[/h3]

[b]The gate of my shrine will open soon, be patient.
This letter will answer your expectations——
Accept my knowledge, face my power.
Who are you, what do you wish for？
Tell me, why pursue power that doesn't belong to you
For family heritage, for blood feuds?——or are they two sides of the same coin?[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/82d406ca1e1bcec0a83d626648881c6ff5f3757b.png[/img]
[i]🧩When the fools stayed loyal to the old god, to mediocrity, she turned to me. Clever choice.[/i]

[h3]💥Power over Partner[/h3]
[b]Not your friends, but your minions——We don’t fraternize, we dominate. 
Have them at your beck and call——as your power, or as your cost.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/aac033e52a0105a63a7926667b0ed94d721a1caa.png[/img]
[i]🧩Once your enemies. Now your soldiers. How’s that sound?[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/5a71749e7b6d26aea32ab11b3bf750e9074fa595.png[/img]
[i]🧩Greater the power, greater the cost. Ready to give it all?[/i]

[h3]💨New Enemies, New Challenges[/h3]
[b]Tread carefully on your way to me.
You might have won countless battles, but don’t be so sure this time.[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/404438dcd7ecf6122d37818de4c75c5b69782928.png[/img]
[i]🧩Interesting……He's not willing to show his true face. Well, just like the rest of us…[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/b2de72c0747c9b9cc69ff06cd5ffc07c76185158.png[/img]
[i]🧩He does more than damage. Maybe you need new strategies, too.[/i]

[h3]✝️Pray, Mortals, Pray[/h3]
[b]For you mortals, this journey has not been easy.
However, only the most devout can see the truth.
Come, step into my shrine
Bath in my grace, or my wrath. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/cc8a84765b6732125e69ee7ed7baa026a3c30f53.png[/img]

[h3]❓Still Curious?[/h3]
[b]Ask anything in the comments
My knowledge is boundless - but what you willing to pay for it?[/b]

 
[h3]🌫️The brand new DLC for Indies’ Lies is coming soon. Meet me across the dark mist.🌫️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/12e1b5a9113a00dec04e82285bd4c1c25d095e7b.png[/img]

[b]There will be more preview of the DLC content. Stay tuned!
[/b][i]Please note that art displayed in this post does not represent the final result.[/i]

Fun Square Games

notes.title: New Mode, New Skins, New Map, New Boss! - Happy Lunar New Year!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Mekaa Adventurers,
[/h3]
[b]👋It's been a while and we're back with a bunch of new content to celebrate the Lunar New Year. The game is also 40% OFF - Don't miss out! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638390

[h3]🚆"Cangyuan Land" New Mode[/h3]

[b]🐉Enter the New Year theme dungeon - "Dragon Abyss Secret Realm", a new map gameplay rule, and challenged the new BOSS with heroes![/b]

[previewyoutube=6nJlRC035DQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In the ancient land of legends, a loud roar shattered the peace that originally belonged to this place. The dragon should be a symbol of strength and wisdom, but this time it failed to stop the invasion of magic bronze and became the slave of Indis. Under the threat of hot steel and giant hammers, the dragon danced wildly and roared for nine days, eventually leaving behind a ruined home and crying people.

“The sleeping dragon is not rising today. Please come to the high platform.” Dear heroes, “Dragon Abyss” is about to open. [b]Let us put on our armor again, in the darkness and fire, and strike the heavy note of the new year![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/b68af6363c41a15e4346cf4cf0b65c73209a7dea.png[/img]

Dragon Abyss Secret Realm has a total of 10 levels. Each level has 8 cells, except for the boss, which are all shrouded in fog. Players can consume moves to reveal the fog of any cell, and then decide whether to enter. Entering a cell will not consume moves.

[h3]🎆5 New Festive Skins[/h3]

Get 5 new skins that we prepare for the lunar new year! 
You can get exchange coins by clearing the new dungeon, which can be used to exchange new skins and card effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/57b1bbd449c1c41b8ddb9ae1f5a3dafb7560cc31.png[/img]

[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
- Added options for difficulty rewards in advanced mode so you can choose difficulty rewards freely.
- Optimized some art resources.
- Fixed an error caused by the talent "Vengeance", which resulted in the enemy giving cards to teammates wrongly

Please let us know your feedback or suggestions via Steam community or [url=https://discord.gg/zT27CC3ZmG]Discord[/url]!

Enjoy gaming & Happy Lunar New Year!
Fun Square

notes.title: A Brief Recap of 2023
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Mekaa adventurers,[/h3]

In January, we released the full version of Indies' Lies. Since then, we've been optimizing gameplay and balance, and added the skin system, the "Taint" custom difficulty system, and new skins for several characters. Along the way, your support has been our fuel.

In 2024, we'll be bringing new modes (slated for Lunar New Year!) a new DLC, and more new skins! We'll continue to optimize the gameplay and balance based on player feedback.

notes.title: Custom Difficulty is Live! – V1.1.0 Update Log
notes.content:
[h3]New Feature: “Taint” Custom Difficulty System
[/h3]
Dear Mekaa Adventurers,

Brace yourself for the V1.1.0 update with a custom difficulty system! We’ve [b]replaced the 20-level progression with this new system[/b]. It’s time to set your own rules! 

This new difficulty system has [b]24 options in total[/b]. Toggle on your desired options to add challenges to a run. Each option comes with a [b]“Taint” score[/b]. The higher sum it adds up to, the harder the game gets! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/bf196beb4485f8712ca72883dc870414586325f1.png[/img]

To smooth you into the new system, your highest level beaten from the old level progression will be translated into your starting Taint cap. The Taint sum of your selected options could not exceed that cap. To raise the Taint cap, you need to finish a run with max Taint. We can’t wait to find out who’ll be the first to beat [i][b]the ultimate 99 Taint[/b][/i]!

[b]Highest level beaten → Starting Taint cap
[/b]20 → 50
19 → 48
18 → 46
17 → 44
16 → 42
15 → 40
14 → 37
13 → 36
12 → 34
11 → 32
10 → 30
9 → 25
8 → 25
7 → 25
6 → 20
5 → 20
4 → 20
3 → 15
2 → 15
1 → 10
0 → 5

We have also updated the difficulty mode selection (Easy / Normal / Advanced) and placed it on the chapter selection screen. [b]The custom difficulty system is unlocked at Advanced Mode[/b], and you’ll be able to choose between these modes when you start a new run. 

[h3]Updated Feature: Camp Rewards
[/h3]

We made the camp rewards more consistent, so rewards from the same camp will grant the same type of perks, for example card removal. When you enter the later stages, you will find in the camp options the same camp that you have selected at the previous stage.

* Details of the new rewards can be found in camp information.

[h3]Other updates:
[/h3][list]
[*] Removed monster skills with a 30-second time limit.
[*] Rohan’s talent “Life Blessing” now increases his temporary max HP by 15% instead of 20%.
[*] Perry’s talent “Blood Displacement” now increases his strength by 5 instead of 6.
[*] Ranger talent “Swordster” now grants 12 block instead of 8.
[*] Fire buff now takes effect after all block-related buff take effect.
[/list]
[h3]The game will be 20% off from May 23 to May 30. Get a copy for yourself or your strategy-loving friend!
[/h3]

notes.title: Indies' Lies Full Release now!
notes.content:
[h3]After a year in Early Access, Indies' Lies has left Early Access![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/c6c5a822dd7f734cf18e56d05c501ab551f3cb63.png[/img]
[h3]Full Release Content Overview[/h3]
Dear Adventurers!

Finally! After 7 years in development and 1 year in Early Access We are moving to the Full Release!
Indies' Lies now officially offers the following new content：
✔️[i][b]Knights DLC with Rohan, Grace, and Perry to join the other 9 playable heroes[/b][/i]
✔️Reworked Rune System to enhance card modification depth
[b]-[/b] Now Runes can be attached to all cards, you can also attach up to 3 runes to one card.
[b]-[/b] Rework all 83 Rune Cards.
✔️[i][b]Reworked Class Cards for more complex synergy between buffs[/b][/i]
[b][i][u]Rework some Wizard Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We introduced the concept of "Even Psychic" to emphasize a more focused manipulation of Mekaa's witchcraft. We have also made builds based on Fire, Elements, View Cards, and Runes more powerful on a higher difficulty.
[b][i][u]Rework some Ranger Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We added a "Terminate" feature to display rangers' dexterity as they finish their attacks. At the same time, as rangers roam the Mekaa land with many skills, we enhanced synergies between builds with different features (such as Poison, Stab, and Thorn).
[b][i][u]Rework some Mechanists Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We added the concept of "Overload" to highlight that some old machinery is not fully developed (but can still be put to good use). We have also designed a new Auto experience with the new "Overload Scale", adding a "calculating" personality to the mechanists.

✔️[i][b]Reworked Talent System & enhanced many Talents[/b][/i]
Up to 120 talents have been optimized, with some new UI on the talent board and the maps. Some of the weaker talents have also been enhanced so that you have something to gain whenever you learn a new talent.

✔️[i][b]Added Special Battle Modes & Minigames[/b][/i]
You will encounter two "special battles" - Trial and Resentment on the map. We took inspiration from other games, such as a limited-time challenge with a huge flow of monsters in Hades, or Auto gameplay where the card sequence decides your results in Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game. These special battles will reward you with powerful artifacts that could boost you for the rest of the run!

✔️[i][b]Adjusted Difficulty according to feedback & Learning Curve[/b][/i]
With the above changes, the difficulty of the game has changed dramatically. It will be harder for beginners but easier to get better. We will continue to adjust the difficulty of the game based on your data - we hope that all players could have fun playing <Indies' Lies>!

[h3]DLC Knights will be free for 7 days after the Full Release![/h3]
To celebrate [b]Indies' Lies[/b] finally leaving Early Access, we decided to make the Knights DLC free for 7 days after the release. The DLC offers Rohan, Grace, and Perry as playable characters & allows you to dive into their stories.

[h3]Your feedback will make us very happy![/h3]
We appreciate your feedback! Share your thoughts here in the comments or leave a review on Steam. We welcome you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/GN4Dfq52AD]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/IndiesLies]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/IndiesLies]Facebook[/url].

[i]Thank you for staying with Indies' Lies![/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638390/Indies_Lies/

[h2][b]What's New in this Beta
[/b][/h2]
Overview: We've been developing and polishing the game for the past 4 months, with a goal to optimize the pace, strategy and balance of the game.  We've also added a few new features that we're experimenting with. Hope you'll enjoy them!

[b]- [Runes][/b]: Runes can now be attached to any card, and multiple runes can be attached to one card.

[b]- [Wizards][/b]: We introduced the concept of "Even Psychic" to emphasize a more focused manipulation of Mekaa's witchcraft. We have also made builds based on Fire, Elements, View Cards, and Runes more powerful on higher difficulty.

[b]- [Rangers][/b]: We added a "Terminate" feature to display rangers' dexterity as they finish their attacks. At the same time, as rangers roam the Mekaa land with many skills, we enhanced synergies between builds with different features (such as Poison, Stab and Thorn).

[b]- [Mechanists][/b]: We added the concept of "Overload" to highlight that some old machinery is not fully developed (but can still be put to good use). We have also designed a new Auto experience with the new "Overload Scale", adding a "calculating" personality to the mechanists.

[b]- [Talents][/b] Up to 120 talents have been optimised, with some new UI on the talent board and the maps. Some of the weaker talents have also been enhanced, so that you have something to gain whenever you learn a new talent.

[b]- [Special Battles] [/b]: You will encounter two "special battles" - Trial and Resentment on the map. We took inspirations from other games, such as a limited-time challenge with a huge flow of monsters in [i]Hades[/i], or an auto gameplay where the card sequence decides your results in [i]Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game[/i]. These special battles will reward you with powerful artifacts that could boost you for the rest of the run!

[b]-[Difficulty] [/b]With the above changes, the difficulty of the game has changed dramatically. It will be harder for beginners but easier to get better. We will continue to adjust the difficulty of the game based on your data - we hope that all players could have fun playing <Indies' Lies>!

Added card filter in the deck screen.
Players can now use ESC, SPACE or ENTER to close the card information screen called by right mouse click.
Optimized the battle background effects in The Other World.
Fixed some text errors.
Other bugfixes.

The feedback we have received about the game difficulty has been quite divided. Some players find the starting levels too easy and thus boring, but some like the fact that it's easier to get the hang of game. For now, we've made the starting levels a bit more challenging, but it will be a long-term task for us to adjust the difficulty curve to try and deliver a great experience for everyone.

notes.content:
Hi Mekaa Adventurers! 

We're here with a new patch for Indies' Lies that will take care of the following:

Bugfixes
1. Fixed the following issues which might stop the game from continuing: 
1.1 Closing shop too fast
1.2 Failure to return to map 
1.3 Tutorial screen issues
1.4 Display order of deck
2. Shut down the special effects on the Talent screen that caused lower fps

Art
1. Made changes to costumes on Grace and Karma
2. Adjusted special effect layers on some monsters

We understand that some of you find the game too easy in the beginning levels. We'll definitely work on that, but difficulty adjustment will take time so please be patient! We've also scheduled the new feature where you can view card details by hovering over it.

Thanks for all the prompt feedback! I'm sure a lot of you have made it to the more challenging levels. And have you tried out our story mode? Let us know what you think!
